empty.label: Full spare lantern in front of an empty one
empty.explanation: A Warrior wields a Lantern with 500 turns of fuel, has no flask of oil, and carries two spare Lanterns: one with 5000 turns, then one with 0. Original: the scan starts at the last lantern (empty), finds nothing to use and the Borg does not refuel (unmet need). Corrected: the scan starts at the full lantern and the Borg refuels with it.
